fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 1: Our Internal Medicine Residency program began in July 2001, obtaining its initial accreditation by the American Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) the following year. In 2007, we were granted 10 years of Continued Accreditation by the ACGME, putting us in a privileged position.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 2: Our program is a perfect combination of a high quality training environment with a mission driven hospital whose commitment to education and constant support is key in our continued growth. Striving to prepare physicians to practice high quality Internal Medicine, applying superior clinical judgement and deliver innovative and effective health care to society, we emphasize on evidence-based medicine and clinical problem solving. Therefore, aligning with our sponsoring institutions mission to provide services of the highest quality to our patients.
fields.PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS · Highlight 3: With a dynamic curriculum and rich environment, we promote growth and independence for residents which prepares them for the next stage of their career, either if their goal is being a primary care physician, hospitalist, or subspecialty fellow. Furthermore, our strong inpatient and ambulatory program emphasizes the importance of education in all six competencies. Our residency program has an in-house Continuity Clinic, allowing residents to follow-up on patients with all the necessary information at their fingertips through the Electronic Health Record system. Thus, with a vast variety of subspecialist on-site, residents are able to consult any situation that may arise during patient’s follow-up visit.
